equity_bridge.item: Publicly-held equity securities at 75% of Jul-26-2026 fair value
equity_bridge.note: 42,783 marketable equity securities (Q2 FY2027 10-Q, Level 1/2) less a 25% haircut for the 36.9B lock-up restriction and the post-July AI-equity drawdown. The prior valuation carried 30.2B of these inside cash. Non-marketable stakes (51,157) excluded entirely; the Anthropic IPO (expected ~Nov 19-20) would move part of them into this line.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2028 management commentary (~70% YoY, supply-bound) haircut to 50% for the base; no historical CAGR is a usable forward anchor after a 3-year 100% revenue CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3y CAGR 92% vs revenue 100% and EPS 204%: all three are artefacts of the FY2023 trough and the FY2024-26 AI ramp; none is projectable.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs are on owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2021 3,240; FY2023 831; FY2026 87,990. The owner-FCF 3y CAGR (373%) exceeds the reported (194%) because SBC was 71% of reported FCF at the FY2023 trough and is 6.6% now: the SBC burden has fallen, not risen, which is the reverse of the usual warning. Windows: 3y = FY2023-FY2026, 5y = FY2021-FY2026.

scenario_narratives.base: Blackwell Ultra and Vera Rubin ship against the 279B supply book; FY2027 lands ~405B and FY2028 grows ~50% (management says ~70%, the market ~45%) before hyperscaler capex growth moderates and custom silicon (TPU, Trainium, MTIA) takes inference share at the margin. Revenue compounds 20% a year to FY2031 then settles to 3%. Adjusted EBITDA margin eases from 67% to 55% as the >15% system price increases only partly offset memory costs and pricing power normalises. Working capital consumes a quarter of each year's revenue increase, as it has for three years. China Data Center compute stays at zero throughout. The three-customer concentration and the guarantee book are carried in the weights, not the base flows.
scenario_narratives.bull: The Analysis bull: supply remains the only constraint through FY2028 and management's ~70% FY2028 growth is largely delivered (65%), the Rubin ramp holds share in training where CUDA remains unchallenged, and the 500B+ of third-party financing MOUs and the AI-cloud-partner model keep ecosystem demand funded without NVIDIA's own balance sheet. Price increases restore gross margin to 72-73% in FY2028 and operating margin holds 60-65% through FY2031. Revenue reaches ~1.2T by FY2031 and ~1.5T by FY2037; the capital-return programme (0.25 quarterly dividend, 99B buyback authorisation) is funded from flows.
scenario_narratives.bear: The funding-freeze bear the user framed, harsher than the Analysis bear: FY2028 still grows 25% on procured supply, then a failed IPO, a neocloud default or a hyperscaler capex cut closes the capital markets every leveraged buyer depends on. Orders stop, revenue falls 20% in FY2029 and 5% in FY2030, the 279B supply commitments become inventory and purchase-commitment charges, and adjusted EBITDA margin drops to 50%. An OpenAI-linked partner defaults and NVIDIA assumes ~60-65B of data-centre lease obligations under the 108.5B guarantee book (modelled as a lease charge over FY2029-36). Customer equity stakes are marked down. Revenue regains the FY2027 level only in FY2031 and grows 3-6% thereafter; the business survives comfortably on a net-cash balance sheet, but the terminal multiple is that of a cyclical.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Ten-year owner-FCF component DCF off an FY2027E revenue base of ~405B, SBC fully expensed and the share count held flat. The base case gives NVIDIA a 20% revenue CAGR to FY2031 and a mature 55% adjusted EBITDA margin, which is generous by any semiconductor precedent and still assumes the AI build-out decelerates rather than reverses. The model deliberately gives no credit for 51B of private customer stakes, haircuts the 43B of public ones by 25%, and omits the ~3/share of H2 FY2027 cash accruing before FY0 ends. What it cannot do mechanically is price the correlation at the heart of the bear case: NVIDIA's largest customers, its equity stakes, its guarantees and its receivables all depend on the same capital markets staying open. That correlation is why the bear weight stays at 25% and why the bear itself is a revenue decline with guarantees crystallising, not a growth slowdown. The investment question is whether today's price, which sits close to the base case, is enough margin for a business whose terminal-year earnings are a judgment about mid-cycle, not a trend.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration and circular financing: three direct customers = 44% of H1 FY2027 revenue; 99B of equity stakes, 108.5B of maximum guarantee exposure (105B SB Energy/OpenAI) and 279B of supply commitments are all tied to the same AI-lab/neocloud funding market. A funding freeze hits revenue, equity marks, receivables and guarantees at once.

Cash conversion: Q2 FY2027 FCF 21.4B on 59.7B net income; receivables +24.6B and inventory +10.2B in H1. Working capital is modelled at -25% of the revenue change; if DSO keeps rising the base owner-FCF margin is overstated.

Custom silicon: Google TPU, Amazon Trainium, Meta MTIA scaling in inference; a Meta TPU shift for training from 2027 could divert ~10% of revenue. The five largest customers are all trying to need NVIDIA less.
Gross margin: guided down from 75.0% to ~74% (Q3) and 71-72% (Q4) on HBM/DRAM costs, with recovery to 72-73% in FY2028 dependent on >15% system price increases sticking.
China is a structural zero in guidance; a SAMR antitrust finding on the Mellanox undertakings and export-control escalation (RASA) remain open.
New leverage: 25B of senior notes in June 2026 (total debt 33.4B) alongside a 24B/yr dividend and 39B of H1 buybacks; capital return now runs ahead of reported FCF.
Key-person: the independent board review of the CEO (Nov 2026) can gap the price either way; it does not change the ten-year flows unless it changes the succession structure.
Terminal-year judgment: 47% of base value sits in the terminal; the mature 55% adjusted EBITDA margin and 3% growth are assertions about mid-cycle, not observations.

prior_version.method: hand-built 5-year DCF, flat FCF margin 45/47/43%, Gordon terminal, FY0 = FY2026 (revenue 215,938), net cash 72,102 incl. 30.2B marketable equity securities

bridge.item: Prior file's stated assumptions re-run exactly: hand-built arithmetic does not reproduce (bear 50.22 / base 116.30 / bull 194.27 vs 52.17 / 115.72 / 185.19)
Anchor refresh: net cash 72,102 -> 55,307 (23,220 cash+debt securities less 33,366 debt after the June 25B note issue, plus 32,087 marketable equity at 75%); diluted shares 24,286 -> 24,285

Driver change within the prior method: revenue base rolled from FY2026 actual 215,938 to FY2027E 405,000 and growth path FY2028-32 re-judged to 50/20/10/5/4 (base), 65/30/20/15/8 (bull), 25/-20/-5/5/6 (bear) against the prior's 35/28/22/16/12 etc.

Methodology: flat 45% FCF margin, 5-year -> component build (adj. EBITDA fading 67->55%, SBC 2%, cash tax 16.5->18%, capex 2.5%, WC -25% of revenue change), 10-year horizon, 15x terminal cap (binds in bull only), bear guarantee charge; per-scenario: bear -6.59, base -11.97, bull -16.59
Price move 186.64 -> 173.73: no effect on IV; upside moves from -39.9% to +1.4%

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2027E = H1 FY2027 actual 177,837 + Q3 guide 108,000 (midpoint, zero China DC compute) + Q4 estimate ~119,000 (+10% q/q, below the +12% Q3 guide step). Street sits ~400-410B. Replaced by the FY2027 10-K actual at the next refresh.
inputs.share_count_basis: diluted weighted average, Q2 FY2027 10-Q (Jul 26, 2026), treasury-stock method; held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows. Buybacks (39,044 H1 FY2027) are what keeps the count flat and are value-neutral here.
inputs.cash_note: cash 22,443 + marketable DEBT securities 34,143 (Q2 FY2027 10-Q balance sheet). Marketable EQUITY securities (42,783, of which 36.9B lock-up restricted customer/partner stakes) are NOT in cash; they enter via equity_bridge at a 25% haircut. Non-marketable securities (51,157: private stakes in customers/partners) get zero credit. Total debt = 1,000 short-term + 32,366 long-term after the June 2026 25.0B senior-note issue.
inputs.sbc_source: TTM to Jul 26, 2026 (FY2026 10-K 6,386 - H1 FY2026 3,099 + H1 FY2027 3,954), cash-flow-statement add-back; NVIDIA publishes no combined SBC-plus-equity-award-tax line and its net-share-settlement taxes are not separately disclosed, so the add-back is used alone.
inputs.buyback_note: H1 FY2027 financing-activity repurchases 39,044 (FY2026: 40,158). 99.3B authorization remaining after the May 2026 80B increase; only cash spent is recorded.
inputs.fcf_note: reported_fcf, sbc and interest_income are TTM to Jul 26, 2026 so that last_fcf matches the balance-sheet date. TTM revenue 302,970 -> owner-FCF margin 38.8%, depressed by a 49B H1 FY2027 working-capital build (receivables +24.6B, inventory +10.2B).
inputs.fy0_note: FY2027 ends 2027-01-31 (53-week year); the 10-year explicit horizon runs FY2028-FY2037. H2 FY2027 owner FCF accruing between the Jul-2026 balance sheet and FY0 end (~80B less ~12B dividends) is deliberately omitted: it is worth roughly +3/share and is better taken from the Q3 10-Q (Nov 17) than estimated here.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-11-11T21:00:00Z regular close (Yahoo Finance chart API). VOLATILE: the price is inside a board review of the CEO and five trading days ahead of the Q3 FY2027 report (Nov 17); replace at the next regular close.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. Base 11% = risk-free ~4.1% (10y UST) + beta ~1.6 x ERP ~4.5%, with no separate premium for customer concentration (that risk is carried in the bear weight, not the rate). Bull 10% / bear 12% retained from the prior (2026-06-30) valuation unchanged so the scenarios stay comparable.
inputs.lease_treatment: Operating leases (5.0B long-term liability) are immaterial against the flows and are left inside EBITDA (rent in opex); no lease deduction, no lease liability in net debt. The bear scenario's lease_cost_pct_path is NOT NVIDIA's own leases: it is the assumed crystallisation of the 108.5B land/power/shell and SB Energy guarantees for AI-cloud partners.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, US tech row of the dcf-methods routing table), scenario-weighted, 10-year explicit horizon so the terminal year is a normalised post-ramp year rather than the FY2031 plateau. UPDATE of the 2026-06-30 hand-built DCF (flat 45% FCF margin, 5-year): the switch to the component build is a methodology change and is attributed in the reconciliation bridge. Net cash is small (23B) against a 118B owner-FCF base so the interest-income strip is immaterial, but it is applied for consistency with the cash add-back. Guarantee/customer-financing exposure (108.5B gross guarantees, 99B equity stakes, 279B supply commitments, 3 customers = 44% of H1 revenue) is carried in the bear scenario and in the weights, not as a mechanical debt add: the guarantees are contingent, and if a partner defaults NVIDIA assumes data-centre capacity it can re-let or use, not a pure loss.

bear.growth_note: Funding-freeze / digestion bear, deliberately harsher than the Analysis bear (which keeps a 15-20% CAGR and is closer to this file's base). FY2028 +25% on supply already procured and backlog honoured; FY2029 -20% and FY2030 -5% as 2-3 hyperscalers cut capex, custom silicon takes inference share and the neocloud/lab funding market closes (the 2022 template: revenue -20%). Revenue returns to the FY2027 level only in FY2031.
bear.ebitda_margin_note: FY2028 63%: memory costs not passed through (gross margin high-60s). FY2029-30 50-54%: pricing erodes, inventory and purchase-commitment charges against the 279B supply book. Settles at 52% adj. EBITDA (~46% operating after the guarantee charge), below the Analysis bear's 50-55% operating margin.
bear.lease_cost_note: Guarantee crystallisation, NOT NVIDIA's own leases: an AI-cloud partner (OpenAI/SB Energy) defaults and NVIDIA assumes data-centre lease obligations. 15.5% of revenue cumulatively over FY2029-36 on a ~400-480B revenue base = ~60-65B pre-tax, about 55-60% of the 108.5B maximum gross exposure, the remainder recovered by re-letting or using the capacity. In this scenario the 32B marketable-equity bridge item would also be largely lost (~1.3/share, not modelled separately).

base.growth_note: FY2028 +50%: management says ~70% with supply the binding constraint and 279B of supply commitments already placed; the market is near +45%. 50% assumes the Rubin ramp lands but hyperscaler 2027 capex growth moderates. FY2029 +20%, FY2030 +10% then a 3% steady state: FY2027-31 CAGR 20%, between the Analysis bull (40-45% to FY2029) and bear (15-20%).
base.ebitda_margin_note: Adjusted (pre-SBC) EBITDA. H1 FY2027 actual 69.3% (67.1% GAAP + 2.2% SBC). FY2028 67% = guided 72-73% gross margin less opex ~7% plus D&A/SBC add-backs, haircut for memory costs. Fades to 55% (GAAP operating margin ~51%) as pricing power normalises: still above any semiconductor company's history, and above the Analysis bear's 50-55% operating-margin floor.
base.wc_note: Negative: growth consumes cash (receivables and inventory ahead of payables). Observed capture on the YoY revenue change: FY2025 -22%, FY2026 -31%, H1 FY2027 -56%. -25% costs ~51B in FY2028 and releases cash in any decline year.
base.terminal_note: Cap set at 15x (cyclical) but does not bind: Gordon at 11%/3% is 12.9x.

bull.growth_note: Analysis bull: 40-45% CAGR through FY2029 (here 46%: 65% then 30%, i.e. management's FY2028 ~70% nearly delivered), decelerating to 20%/15% by FY2031 (Analysis says 20-25%; shaded down one notch). FY2031 revenue ~1.2T.
bull.ebitda_margin_note: Analysis bull: GAAP operating margin 60-65%+ held through FY2031 as >15% system price increases pass memory costs through; here 66% adj. EBITDA in FY2031 = ~62.5% operating.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Unchanged from the 2026-06-30 valuation (25/50/25 against the 15/50/35 house default). Bear held at 25%, not 15%, because demand is correlated to a single funding market: three direct customers are 44% of H1 FY2027 revenue, one indirect customer (OpenAI) is 'meaningful', 99B of equity stakes and 108.5B of guarantees sit on the same counterparties, and the Q2 cash-conversion slip (receivables +24.6B, DSO 45 -> 60) shows the earnings are partly still receivables. Bull held at 25%, not 35%, because it needs hyperscaler 2027-28 capex, the FY2028 margin recovery and no custom-silicon share loss to all come through together. The pending CEO board review and the Nov 17 report are catalysts for the price, not the long-run flows, and do not move the weights.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
